name: Zum'rah's Head
summary: Mazu'kon asks you to hunt Zum'rah in Zul'Farrak, where the witch doctor practices his voodoo. He wants Zum'rah's head brought back to Mulgore.

sections.title: A Hunt in Tanaris
sections.body: Mazu'kon in Mulgore sends you south to Zul'Farrak, a Sandfury city in Tanaris. Zum'rah is a witch doctor who practices voodoo there, and Mazu'kon wants him slain. You are to bring the witch doctor's head back to Mulgore.

faq.answer: Zum'rah is a witch doctor who practices voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak.
Zum'rah is in Zul'Farrak, a Sandfury city in Tanaris.

faq.q: Who asks me to hunt Zum'rah?
faq.answer: Mazu'kon in Mulgore asks you to slay Zum'rah and bring back his head.

faq.q: What does Mazu'kon want me to bring back?
faq.answer: Mazu'kon wants you to bring him Zum'rah's head in Mulgore.
